generated_by: authored by hand — this file is the style guide, not an output
note: THE STYLE GUIDE WINS. Every illustration is composed from these tokens by scripts/phonics/illustration-kit.js. Changing a colour here restyles all 352 pages; nothing downstream hard-codes a hex. Departures are recorded in DEPARTURES.md next to this file.

line.note: One weight for silhouettes, one for interior detail, one for whiskers/rays. No other weights are permitted.

fill_stroke_widths.note: A few shapes are drawn as a thick round-capped STROKE rather than a filled path — the bee's belly bands and the tap's spout. These are fills expressed as strokes, not line weights, and are the only widths permitted outside the three above.

radius.note: No sharp corners anywhere. Props round to these three values.

eye.style: solid dark disc + one white highlight disc offset up-left, plus an upper lid arc when a pose needs an expression
eye.note: Every character in every book uses this one eye. It is the single strongest consistency cue at tablet size.

paper.role: page ground — matches the reader's .wps-book background

sky_deep.role: outline on sky, distant hills (darkened from #2f7fa6 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

dusk.role: evening sky. NOT a dark night: at any true night value the cast's warm outlines cannot clear WCAG 3:1 without adding a light rim to every character. A dusk sky with a moon and stars reads as evening to a 3-year-old and stays accessible. See DEPARTURES.md.

grass_deep.role: outline on grass, blade detail (darkened from #2f7a3f in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

earth_deep.role: outline on earth (darkened from #8a5524 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

water_deep.role: outline on water, ripple lines (darkened from #1f6f96 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

sun_deep.role: outline on sun (darkened from #a86a09 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

brick_deep.role: outline on brick (darkened from #94441f in b248 — it only reached 2.57:1 on its own brick fill)

metal_deep.role: outline on metal (darkened from #4c5c68 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

leafy_deep.role: outline on foliage (darkened from #215e2a in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

petal_deep.role: outline on petal (darkened from #a33355 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

white_deep.role: outline on white/cloud/snow (darkened from #5b6a76 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

red.role: added b381 — true bright red for props the briefs call 'red' by name (bell, wig, hat, boat hull, fish, ladybird), distinct from the warmer orange-brown of brick

red_deep.role: outline on red — checked against every ground: worst case 6.70:1 (on earth), outline-vs-own-fill 3.42:1

gold_deep.role: Ned's outline (darkened from #8a5606 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

hedgehog.role: Moss's spines — chestnut brown (Toby, 2026-10-02: "make Moss brown, not pink"; was berry #e0668f)

berry.role: unused since Moss went brown (2026-10-02); kept so nothing that names it breaks

berry_deep.role: Moss's outline (darkened from #8c1f45 in b381 — Moss was never rendered outside book 1 until b381's digging/napping books, which is when outline-vs-own-fill first caught it at 2.70:1; now 3.52:1)

sunflower_deep.role: Nell's outline (darkened from #8a5b04 in b248 to clear WCAG 3:1 on bare earth)

contrast_rules.standard: WCAG 2.1 — 1.4.11 non-text contrast (3:1) for illustration outlines, 1.4.3 (4.5:1) for body text
contrast_rules.note: Checked programmatically by scripts/phonics/check-illustrations.js, never by eye.

meaning_never_by_colour_alone.rule: Each character must be identifiable from silhouette and accessory shape with all colour removed.

silhouettes.pip_sparrow: upright egg body, pointed head tuft, short triangular beak
silhouettes.ned_duckling: low round body, flat wide bill, webbed feet
silhouettes.olive_owl: wide barrel body, two ear tufts, huge round eye discs
silhouettes.moss_hedgehog: low dome with a sawtooth spine ridge, long pointed snout
silhouettes.fig_caterpillar: horizontal run of five discs, two curled antennae
silhouettes.nell_bee: oval body with banded belt, two round wings, hovering above the ground line

meaning_never_by_colour_alone.checked: check-illustrations.js re-renders every scene in greyscale and asserts each character's silhouette path set is unique.

typography.note: Illustrations carry NO text. All words live in the HTML/PDF layer, so no font travels inside an SVG and nothing can fail to embed.

composition.rule: One clear focal character, generous empty ground for the sentence, props never cross the safe inset.
